title: DaBaby Sound-Off On Megan The Stallion On New Single 'Boogeyman,' Says He Slept With Her Before Tory Lanez Allegedy Shot Her Listen
htmlContent:
DaBaby alleges that he hooked up with Megan Thee Stallion on a song from his new album.

On Friday, September 23, DaBaby released his new album of 14 songs, Baby on Baby 2. The album has a title called "Boogeyman," which finds the controversial North Carolina rapper claiming his sexual relationships with Megan Thee Stallion.

"You play with me that shit was childish/The day before she said that Tory Lanez shot her, I was fuckin on Megan Thee Stallion," DaBaby said, as he is clearly referencing Lanez accused of shooting Stallion in 2020.

"Waited to say that shit on my next album/Hit it the day before too/But I kept it player, I ain't say nothing ’bout it/Had her pretty boy, boyfriend tweeting me, ready to die ’bout the bitch like a coward/I told you niggas don't play, now you gone have to handle me/I poked the muthafuckin bear, I'm a animal."

The second half of the single reminds us of DaBaby's June 2021 Twitter encounter with Megan's boyfriend, Pardison Fontaine. The drama was taken to social as Megan and DaBaby exchanged shots on Twitter. After Baby reposted a joke about Tory shooting Megan and showed up on a track with Tory called "Skat."

"YOU NIGGAS IS CORNY alotta you women is corny," Pardi tweeted. "ANY N**** THAT SHOOTS A WOMAN IS P*** ANY N***** THAT SIDES WITH IT ..CONDONES IT AFFILIATES THEY SELF WITH STANDS BESIDE THAT TYPE OF BEHAVIOR IS A B**** ANY WOMAN THAT SUPPORTS IT FOR ANY REASON IS A F***** SAD BITTER OR CONFUSED."
